'''The Bar''' was the name of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] of the [[asteroid base]] [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]]. Visitor [[Xav Verivax]] spent a time there while in Darkside.

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], criminal faction [[The Cell]] performed recruitment tasks in The Bar during paydays, as it was most populated at that point.
